description:
Build a page section by section in a draft, then commit it as one save. Pick the operation with `action` and pass that action's arguments (help:true returns its full documentation and schema).
- start_page_draft: Start a page draft (no network).
- add_draft_section: Append ONE section to a local page draft (NO network — this is the durable per-section cache step that can't time out).
- get_page_draft: Inspect a local page draft: its meta, the section ids, total section count, and (if a commit is in progress) the page_id + committed_count.
- list_page_drafts: List local page drafts for the current site (summaries only: id, name, slug, type, section count, commit progress, updated_at).
- commit_page_draft: Persist a local page draft to the backend INCREMENTALLY (one section per request, 120s timeout each) so no single huge request can time out.
- clear_page_draft: Delete a local page draft (does NOT delete any backend page already created from it).

draft_id.description: Draft id from start_page_draft [add_draft_section, get_page_draft, commit_page_draft, clear_page_draft]

help.description: Return the action's full documentation and argument schema instead of running it

is_homepage.description: Set as the site homepage on commit [start_page_draft]

section.description: A section node (from new_section) — object or JSON string [add_draft_section]

seo.description: SEO for this page → settings.seo (applied on commit). [start_page_draft]

slug.description: URL slug WITHOUT a leading slash, e.g. [start_page_draft]

type.description: Page kind. SPECIAL pages need a site data-source enabled on commit: store→use_store, member→use_m… [start_page_draft]

name: page_draft
